text:
Ivan Barbashev's season looks ordinary on the scoresheet (two goals, 11 points in 18 games) and very good everywhere else. Vegas gets nearly 60 percent of the expected goals at 5v5 with him on the ice, 8.4 points better than when he sits. That fits Evolving-Hockey's read of last season, when he was worth 2.2 wins above replacement, 42nd among forwards.

The goals are the missing piece. He's shooting 8.3 percent against a usual range around 14, and he's 1.34 goals under what his chances would usually produce. One caution the other way: he plays beside strong teammates, which flatters on-ice numbers, and his on-ice finishing is running a bit hot.

He's still one of the faster forwards in the league by NHL EDGE skating data, and he still sits on the end of Jack Eichel and Mitch Marner's passes. Our projection lands around 54 points. If the shooting normalises, a goal streak is close.
headline: Barbashev is driving play, not scoring
